newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: TABLE - Bindura lowers interim shr, div.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Bindura lowers interim shr, div.

text.p: Full name: Bindura Nickel Corporation Limited.

Note:- The corporation said it believed that the nickel market, which saw the LME nickel price fall to a low of U.S.$3.03/lb in July, should stabilise during the remainder of the year with price projections of above U.S.$3.20/lb. It said the anticipated lower availability of stainless steel scrap would be a contributory factor to a stable market.

However, it said a higher inflationary trend and punitive interest rates locally, unless offset by a significant devaluation of the Zimbabwe dollar, would result in lower after-tax profits in the second half of the year.
